title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode7 This City, I Really...

meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: se_event_tale_2022_005
se_event_tale_2022_005
se_event_tale_2022_005
I knew you'd be here...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: A-Aunt Nagi...?!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you here...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Because I was worried sick about you, An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: B-But... How did you know I was here? I didn't tell anyone...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: After giving it some thought, in these sorts of situations, An, you don't like to rely on others. And when it started to rain, I figured you'd want to go somewhere no one would find you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Also, remember what you said?
“It'd be kinda fun to go exploring.”

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. What if I told you that I can recall everything you've ever said, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You're safe now, An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I-I-It was so scary, Aunt Nagi...!!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to see that you've settled down.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And the rain's starting to let up, so let's go home. I'm sure your father and the others are all very worried...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
No!
I'm never ever going home!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy promised that he'd come watch me practice, but he didn't...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: And everyone around town is always hogging Daddy and his team for themselves...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Th-That's why... I hate Daddy and everyone around here! I'm never ever going home!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
...
I understand why you're so angry, An.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Let me start by apologizing to you...
I'm very sorry for not seeing you today and keeping Ken from doing the same...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: He actually wanted to be with you very much, An...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: However, the live house we've been performing at for a very long time ran into some trouble and desperately needed our help...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Ken even kept asking to see if you'd received his message and wondering if he'd made you cry all the way up until we had to take the stage...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Then, his face went completely pale after he heard that you'd run away and dashed off to look for you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want you to know that you mean the world to him and he loves you more than anything else.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
But...
If he cares about me so much, then he wouldn't break his promises, would he...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: He'd choose to be with me, right...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I guess it just means we care about a lot of things...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Of course, we care about you the most, An, but...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We also care about this place very much...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Why do you, Daddy and Uncle Taiga all care about this city so much...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
That's because...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I've been singing here a lot ever since I was little. Like you, An...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: You too, Aunt Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yes. Music lovers have been gathering here forever it seems, and they'd always cheer for me, try to give me tips and all sorts of other things... It really bothered me at first...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I was also able to grow as a singer because of that.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Remember that trick I taught you for singing high notes from your diaphragm? I learned that from someone from this street.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I had so much trouble with it initially, but I eventually managed to figure it out thanks to everyone's support. They even congratulated me after they learned that I did.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sometimes different people would try to put me down by saying how bad I was, but I usually did everything I could to prove them wrong like I had a chip on my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And I'm standing here today because they were there for me back then.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Nagi, Taiga and I were all able to grow as singers because of this town.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Is that what Daddy meant by what he said...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Plus, this is where we met Ken. Things weren't easy back then since he and Taiga didn't really get along at first...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, they didn't?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yes. Strange, right?
They ended up fighting a lot because they had starkly different talents and having contrasting views about artistry.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: They used to fight...? Like the rappers we saw the other day?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, there were definitely times like that.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But everyone around town thought that they were good rivals and helped stop them from fighting. As a result, they began to understand each other better.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Without them, we probably wouldn't be a team right now...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Everyone around town...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Daddy and his team decided to join together because of them? That's how they became really cool singers...?)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We care very much about this place because we went through all these things together.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I didn't know...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Not only that, An, you're the apple of everyone's eye around town, no...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Just think about it. The manager of the live house near your place always cheers you on when you practice, right?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: The manager? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, good morning!
How's it going? Good?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, never better!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I remember him being so excited about you coming into our world while your mother was still pregnant with you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: He even drove her to the hospital a few times during her pregnancy.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: He probably cried the most when you were born too! You should've seen the look on Ken's face!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: He did...? I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Also, remember when you got lost when you were about three...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh, I don't actually remember...
But I think Mommy and Daddy have mentioned that story to me before...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
We looked all over town for you...
Fortunately, this punkish-looking kid with a ton of piercings found and brought you back to us while holding hands with you.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Piercings...? Hang on. Are you talking about the guy from the record store?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Correct.
That was your friend from the record store.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And that girl you often see on her way home from work in the morning... She was a real piece of work when she was younger, but one day, you complimented her by saying, “Your nails are so pretty!” After that, she started liking kids.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Now, she's studying and saving up to become a preschool teacher.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She likes her current job, but she says taking care of kids like you, An, is what makes her happy. So, she's working really hard to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Like me...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And there's lots and lots more people who really care about you, An.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Which is why, An, we don't want you hating us. At least, that's how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Good luck with practice today, An!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I love the way you sing, An♪

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: I have a song that I'd like to recommend. Would you like to hear it...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(She's right...
They all go out of their way to talk to me...)

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: An, is everything alright? You don't sound very happy today. Is your throat okay?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Oh, is it because your dad's been too busy to watch you practice...?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An.
Once he has time, I'm sure... No, I'm absolutely certain that he'll come watch you practice.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (They show their concern for me and stop by to listen to me sing...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (They're all really nice to me...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Because they're all really nice to me, Daddy and his team want to do the same for them and help them out when they need it...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (While I...)
An!!
An!!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? Is someone calling my name...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like they're here.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, who's here...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You'll find out when you get there, so let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Over here!!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
What...?!
But it's nighttime! Why are there so many...?!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wah!!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
I'm so glad you're safe...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (He's drenched...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Was he looking for me in the rain this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for breaking our promise, An. Please, forgive me...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I've never seen this kind of expression on his face before...)

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry too, An!
I asked them for their help without knowing that they'd already made plans with you...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
I'm sorry as well!
I absolutely regret not finding you sooner...!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Still, thank goodness you're safe!
We were all so worried about you!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Oh, hang on... Where's Taiga?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
He went off to get An's mother!
He should be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad they're in the loop...

rows.Speaker: Local Residents
rows.Line:
I need to let my family know as well.
They're probably still out looking for her.

rows.Speaker: Local Residents
rows.Line:
Hi, Mom?
We found An! Yeah, she's safe!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: See...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: They all care about you just this much.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(And I...
I ended up saying that I hated them...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (But they all...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I'm really, really sorry for making you all worry so much...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Thank you for finding me.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I love you all...!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
*Sob*
An... Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Boss, your face is a mess!
Here, use my handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I love you too, An!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Yeah, us too...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thanks, Nagi...
For finding her... And for everything else. I couldn't be more grateful...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. You should be thanking An for listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: D-Daddy...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I love you and think you're super cool for really caring about everyone around town!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you, An.
Your thoughtful words should keep me going for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hehe. I really worked up an appetite... Oh, Daddy, that curry you always make sounds really good right now!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Then, let's head home.
I hope you're ready for some amazing curry.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah!!
